messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert: GPU OOM surge on runtime-pool-12. Sev=P2. Incident INC-2026-427 created. Tagging @ryan_oncall and @maria_sre
ryan_oncall: ack. taking pager. linking logs: https://gcs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-427/
alex_dev: seeing repeated OOMs on worker 12-3 at 12:03UTC. stack: runtime->kvcache->alloc
maria_sre: @alex can you dump kvcache stats and nvidia-smi for the host? prioritize allocations and slab sizes
alex_dev: uploading logs now. here's a quick excerpt:
```
[12:03:02] OOM: allocator failed, wanted 2147483648 bytes
kvcache: total_keys=2.4M evictions/s=120 miss_rate=0.12
batcher: inflight_tokens=20480 typical_seq=512
```
lee_research: hypothesis: KV cache fragmentation + large batch tail causing spike. Could be a rare sequence length causing KV cache blowout. :thinking_face:
ryan_oncall: customer impact: 4 customers reported 500 errors between 12:03-12:10; mostly dev keys. Ramp back to 0.2% error rate after retries. Filing customer impact note.
alex_dev: mitigation: rolling restart of worker group runtime-pool-12 started (12:08 UTC). temporarily set `max_batch_size=4` on group to reduce peak alloc.
maria_sre: noted. Also toggled `kvcache_evict_threshold=0.65` to force earlier evictions. monitoring memory graph.
sre-ops-bot: deploybot: config change applied to runtime-pool-12: max_batch_size=4 (rollout id r-8892). :white_check_mark:
lee_research: collecting heap traces and kv chunk histograms. requesting ops to share `kvcache.dump` and `nvidia-smi` logs to GCS path.
alex_dev: uploaded `kvcache.dump` and `heap-trace.tar.gz` to https://gcs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-427/artifacts
maria_sre: early signal: OOM spikes stopped after config changes. memory plateaued ~20% below limit.
ryan_oncall: handoff in 1h to morning oncall. Please capture timeline + hypothesis list in this thread. I'll prepare customer comms draft.
alex_dev: timeline so far:
- 12:03 UTC: first run OOMs on runtime-worker-12-3
- 12:05 UTC: spike across pool observed, error rate 3%
- 12:08 UTC: rolling restart + max_batch_size=4
- 12:12 UTC: kvcache_evict_threshold lowered
- 12:20 UTC: errors down to baseline
maria_sre: next steps for RCA: 1) analyze kvcache chunk distribution; 2) reproduce with long-seq workload; 3) consider kv chunk coalescing or compaction; 4) evaluate more aggressive batching backpressure.
lee_research: adding hypothesis tracking comment:
- H1: KV cache fragmentation + large batches cause a sudden allocation request > slab size -> OOM
- H2: kernel-level allocation churn from a particular model variant (v2.3) under certain seq-lengths
- H3: transient GC/compaction bug in kvcache evict path (low prob)
alex_dev: commands I ran to collect logs:
```
rz logs fetch --since 30m --filter="kvcache" --out=inc-1768001111.log
ssh runtime-12-3 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv" > nvidia-12-3.csv
```
maria_sre: tagging @lee_research to run reproducer with model v2.3 long-seq script. link: https://git.redwood.ai/repros/long-seq
lee_research: starting reproducer, will post results in 30m. :running_shirt_with_sash:
ryan_oncall: capturing customer-impact stub: "Between 12:03 and 12:12 UTC a small subset of requests experienced 500 errors due to a runtime OOM; mitigation applied and full service restored by 12:20 UTC. No PII exposed." Draft saved to GCS.
maria_sre: good. i'll add metrics graphs and attach kvcache histograms to the RCA doc.
alex_dev: got a small reproduce locally: confirmed spike in `alloc_large` metric when sequence length > 1024 with batch_size 8. lowering batch to 4 avoided the spike.
lee_research: preliminary reproduce result: model v2.3 with seq=1200 + batch=8 triggers heavy kvcache churn and occasional allocation >2GiB. saving traces.
ryan_oncall: thanks all. I'll hand off to @maria_sre for next shift. please keep timeline + artifacts updated.
maria_sre: taking handoff. leaving a short runbook for follow-ups: collect kvcache hist, try compaction patch #452 on canary, evaluate long-term config: `max_batch_size` per-model and `kvcache_compact_interval` tuning.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-427 updated: status=mitigated, responders=[ryan_oncall,maria_sre,alex_dev,lee_research].
